snippet.title: The Last Golfer - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Last Golfer is out now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537630

In addition to our groundbreaking golfing mechanics, players will face challenges, battle enemies and solve intriguing puzzles as they journey through the deadliest courses in the universe. 

The Last Golfer is a third-person golf action game. Stranded on a mysterious planet, a robot must golf its way through to escape. #TheLastGolfer #Steam https://www.thelastgolfer.com/
